text:
alex: Quick heads-up — I'm doing a short v2 migration office hours at 3pm PST today to sync cross-team. Agenda: SDK deprecation windows, embeddings schema delta, proxy header propagation for private stacks. If you want a 5-min slot drop your blocker here.

maria: Thanks — can we confirm the SDK deprecation timeline? Our mobile SDK needs a 2-week opt-in flag before disabling v1.

alex: Yes, recommended default: soft-deprecate (warn header + telemetry) for 30 days, then 2-week hard-disable window for clients who opt-in to auto-migrate. Docs: https://go/release/v2-migration (short link).

sam: Quick question — embeddings change: are we adding/renaming fields in the response schema? That will break our offline indexer.

alex: embeddings v2 adds `model_version` and changes `vector` -> `embedding` (same shape). We'll keep a compatibility shim for 3 months but recommend moving.

kevin: heads-up: eng-runtime needs to land the proxy header propagation patch for Private (X-RW-User / x-rw-context) before we can enable canaries there. ETA EOD tomorrow for the small change + tests.

indra: @kevin correct — I can cut a canary with the header patch once the test harness is green. I also need a list of customers to smoke-test.

jen: For rollout ownership: Platform will own the canary toggles and rollout dashboards. Who owns rollback runbooks?

pm_zoe: PM side — I'll coordinate customer communication. Please tag me for any customer-impacting changes; we should aim for a 7-day notice for customers on Dedicated/Private.

alex: Good — action items: 1) @maria, confirm mobile team's opt-in flow by EOD today; 2) @indra/@kevin pair to post canary URL once ready; 3) @jen prepare rollback runbook draft (3 bullets) before the office hours.

maria: I can do that. Also: mobile will likely need the telemetry header we discussed (`X-RW-Deprecation-Warn`).

sam: One more: sample curl for testing embeddings v2 I used in local smoke:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v2/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input": "hello world", "model": "embed-small-v2"}'
```

deploy-bot: Canary deployed: canary/v2-embeddings -> eng-runtime-canary-3 (id: canary-8808) — smoke tests: 12/12 passed :white_check_mark:

kevin: Thanks deploy-bot — I'll run a quick manual prefix-cache validation on that canary and post results in this thread.

alex: Great — if no other blockers I'll run the office hours agenda and we can triage any last-minute asks live. See you at 3pm PST. :calendar:
